title: Sara Duterte defense lacks counter-witness on P817M asset gap -- Kapunan

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte-Carpio has failed to present an expert witness to counter the financial findings of the prosecution panel, lawyer Lorna Kapunan said Saturday. Kapunan, a counsel for the House prosecutors, expressed surprise after examining the list of 25 defense witnesses submitted to the Senate impeachment court, noting that none appear equipped to rebut the testimony of forensic financial audit expert Alexander Cabrera. “Nakakapagtaka nga… kasi nakita namin sa list of witnesses na wala silang linista na witness na mag-e-explain the discrepancy, wala silang maitapat sa aming witness na si Atty.
